programme.title: 洪武三十二
programme.desc: 明太祖朱元璋驾崩，传位长子之子朱允炆(陈山聪)，但遗诏不知所踪，其近身侍卫敖笑风(谢天华)奉命追查，在查探过程中认识了燕王朱棣(马德钟)的得力谋臣马三保(陈键锋)，二人斗智斗力，惺惺相惜，但笑风得知朱棣正密谋夺位，唯对三保保持戒心。笑风一次执行任务受伤失忆，由心狠手辣的作风变回有恻隐之心，一向痛恨锦衣卫的永晹公主朱樱(江若琳)却怀疑性情变好的笑风另有图谋，着好友三保小心防备。失掉记忆后的笑风虽续受允炆重用，却对身边人心存疑虑，像神秘女子沈千三(徐子珊)和为人深藏不露的朱棣，每次碰面总让他内心泛起一种难以形容但熟稔的感觉；在一次奉命歼灭朱棣的行动中笑风得知了一个秘密，令他身陷义愤与自责的交战中……

programme.title: 与谍同谋
programme.desc: 坐拥美容事业王国的卓君临(罗嘉良)两任妻子相继离世，剩下继女卓敏莉(黄心颖)共同生活，渐渐开始寻索人生的下半场，他遇见了足智多谋的年青人潘少杰(郑俊弘)，君临在他身上看见少年时候的自己，份外有一种亲切感，其贴身秘书陈唏文(李佳芯)也特别赏识这位新入职的市场部经理，确知他必能带领公司更上一层楼；唏文自丈夫康逸风(曹永廉)无故失踪多年，一直用工作麻醉自己，渐渐将君临和公司的一切成为她的人生目标。少杰表面积极讨好君临和取得唏文的信任，但背后与几位各有专长的伙伴，包括善长收集情报凌晋(张颕康)、社交能手邹佩瑜(汤洛雯)、科技宅女杜志仁(赖慰玲)和变装达人林信辉(胡诺言)，合作偷窃各大财团的商业秘密作为生财工具，已部署多年的少杰，正等待最佳时机发动一次摧毁性的报复行动，一场犹如父子的角力就在无形的战场上慢慢展开……

programme.title: 酒是故乡醇
programme.desc: 古世龙(秦沛)乃酒厂当家，因顾念情义而收留旧情人的私生子阿纯(林家栋)。纯寄人篱下，饱受屈辱，幸其生性豁达，毫不介意任低微的「酒尾公」。世龙妹古瑶(邓萃雯)处处关怀纯，纯对瑶早生情愫，惜瑶念念不忘已逝世的蒸煮师傅裘真(曾伟权)，不能释怀。世龙独子桂生(马德钟)为国从军，音讯杳然，古家以为其已死，替他安排冥婚，新娘是以拉横水渡为生的黎顺风(佘诗曼)。顺风为人执着、硬朗，与古家上下皆合不来，幸得纯从旁劝解，人才像美酒经过蒸酿般越见醇厚。纯其后拜「火王」金吉祥(元华)为师；祥早期丧妻，与瑶同病相怜，发展成一对斗气冤家。世龙中风，古家内部争权夺利，闹得天翻地覆，风只好以大少奶身分担起当家之位，与纯合力助酒厂渡过难关。二人日久生情，岂料生却于此时突然回家。风已为人妻，纯重情义，二人能否冲破沉重的道德枷锁，以真爱酿出醉人美酒？

programme.title: 不懂撒娇的女人
programme.desc: 点石成金的商场管理界女强人凌敏(宣萱)旗下商场获奖无数，更是个超级控制狂，堂妹凌禹勤(唐诗咏)作为她的头号助手，唯命是从、任劳任怨，更练出「伪撒娇」本领，为凌敏摆平不少麻烦。正当凌敏事业得意，有望晋身董事局时，公司竟请来商场推广界鬼才文念深(林文龙)与她平起平坐！这对爱恨交缠的前度情人在职场大斗法，凌敏不惜起用绰号「上海撒破郎」的美女实习生田蜜(高海宁)接近念深以套取情报，岂料田蜜不但觊觎凌敏的事业，更看上她的男人，两女展开激烈斗争！另一边，禹勤揭发花心男友何志超(黎诺懿)北上出轨，在灰心之时遇上最情深的暖男程日晖(王浩信)，以为能与他修成正果，却杀出个甜美温柔的台湾表妹向他表白，禹勤马上相形见拙！更糟糕的是，日晖似乎对婚姻异常恐惧，以结婚为志愿的禹勤，是否嫁杏无期？这对不懂撒娇、能干强悍的堂姊妹，最终是否能扭转厄运，获得幸福？

programme.title: 「回归光影颂」神奇的灯泡
programme.desc: 《神奇的灯泡》：一场停电，打乱了三个平凡人的生活。天性乐观的青年周港康(周嘉洛饰)、失意女编剧黎湘文(江嘉敏饰)、性格暴躁的郑忠(郑子诚饰)，为生活都当上了外卖员。三人各有抱负，却因某次停电而陷入困境。正当前路茫茫之际，三人得知世上竟存在着一个神奇灯泡，只要把灯泡燃亮，即可愿望成真！不过，灯泡只得一个实现梦想的机会，三人当中必有牺牲……

programme.title: 食为奴
programme.desc: 高天宝(王祖蓝)自小吃尽珍馐百味，各种美食经他一尝便知龙与凤，但遭逢家道中落被迫与家仆李卫(胡诺言)流落街头，以卖饱糊口，因美食令他结识了卖艺女子纪慕雪(万绮雯)、京城第一美女年若碧(胡定欣)、少女厨神米小鱼(何雁诗)等人，更因缘际会遇上微服出游的四皇子胤禛(黄智贤)，二人气味相投，被引进到宫内的御膳房当御厨，天宝遇上宿敌蔡鹤亭(林盛斌)，掀起连场龙争虎斗；但天宝万料不到自己竟卷入由八皇子胤禩(张继聪)策动的夺嫡之争中，在劣势下天宝成了胤禛的福将，连番替他反败为胜，但一段意外的婚约却令天宝由一人之下顿贬为丧家狗……

programme.title: 坚离地爱坚离地
programme.desc: 在香港，投身金融、地产、商业是「贴地」举动，富二代王子菲(龚嘉欣饰)却偏爱「离地」，与好友许正伟(陈智燊饰)开设初创科技公司。一次网络黑客事件让子菲见识到IT奇才丁信希(张振朗饰)的厉害，邀他加入公司。信希是一名「离地」毒男，不顾世事，得护士张莱(刘佩钥饰)帮助走出不善沟通的围墙，对她好感渐生；子菲与信希经历分歧，至同心及互补不足，不经意对他产生情愫……子菲本相信科技为世界带来美好，但网络风波相继发生在其父王守勤(李国麟饰)、弟王梓龙(罗梓龙饰)、信希之妹丁信恩(黄心颖饰)身上！

programme.title: 溏心风暴3
programme.desc: 凌丽荧(李司棋)与丈夫黄永正(夏雨)凭着努力从茶餐厅发展成为结合地产业务的集团，丽荧弟弟凌乘风(黄宗泽)更协助他们上市，永正本不欲上市，但因当年许雅麟(李国麟)助他脱罪之恩，一直耿耿于怀，有见许家经营印刷的百年基业面临倒闭危机，便听从乘风献计，可透过合并令两家相得益彰，但永正的弟妇梁顺华(关菊英)及亲弟梁赞(阮兆祥)大力反对，加上与雅麟的太太余秀慧(米雪)有积怨，对许家自诩上等人印象欠佳，但丽荧力撑丈夫终达成合并协议。可惜合并后引发两家一连串的祸端，草根与富豪阶级悬殊激发矛盾丛生，加上二儿子黄围家(王浩信)与许家独生女许贝儿(岑丽香)相爱备受阻挠，最终逼使围家远离伤心地，丽荧心痛不已又承受长女黄以爱(陈敏之)与有妇之夫郑立安(唐文龙)的丑闻煎熬；就连至疼锡的乘风亦性情大变，与好友方希文(黄翠如)关系纠缠不清，两家陷入分拆决裂之余更面临一场酝酿已久的复仇风暴……

programme.title: 多功能老婆
programme.desc: 蓝飞(杨千桦饰)是一位美丽时尚、开朗率真的「多功能」主妇，有一个爱她的建筑师丈夫尚剑雄(黄浩然饰)，一个活泼聪明的儿子尚启佳，生活美满。蓝飞还有两位好闺密：女强人万风华(陈炜饰) 及美丽富太马思蕾(朱晨丽饰)，三女的性格和爱情观南辕北辙，爱情路上各有起跌。剑雄全身投入开拓事业，被揭发出轨后抛妻弃子，出走内地。蓝飞像折翼堕地的天使，独力带着儿子生活，遂把没供完的新楼房分租，与高富帅租客荣浩田(周柏豪饰)经常斗气，笑料百出。机缘巧合下，蓝飞由煮妇变成名厨，浩田即化作双翼助她建立厨艺事业。女人因男人的绝情而枯萎，又因另一男人的深情而再次盛放。此时，剑雄回归复婚，浩田亦主动出击，三角关系僵持不下！

programme.title: 多功能老婆
programme.desc: 蓝飞(杨千桦饰)是一位美丽时尚、开朗率真的「多功能」主妇，有一个爱她的建筑师丈夫尚剑雄(黄浩然饰)，一个活泼聪明的儿子尚启佳，生活美满。蓝飞还有两位好闺密：女强人万风华(陈炜饰) 及美丽富太马思蕾(朱晨丽饰)，三女的性格和爱情观南辕北辙，爱情路上各有起跌。剑雄全身投入开拓事业，被揭发出轨后抛妻弃子，出走内地。蓝飞像折翼堕地的天使，独力带着儿子生活，遂把没供完的新楼房分租，与高富帅租客荣浩田(周柏豪饰)经常斗气，笑料百出。机缘巧合下，蓝飞由煮妇变成名厨，浩田即化作双翼助她建立厨艺事业。女人因男人的绝情而枯萎，又因另一男人的深情而再次盛放。此时，剑雄回归复婚，浩田亦主动出击，三角关系僵持不下！

programme.title: 食为奴
programme.desc: 高天宝(王祖蓝)自小吃尽珍馐百味，各种美食经他一尝便知龙与凤，但遭逢家道中落被迫与家仆李卫(胡诺言)流落街头，以卖饱糊口，因美食令他结识了卖艺女子纪慕雪(万绮雯)、京城第一美女年若碧(胡定欣)、少女厨神米小鱼(何雁诗)等人，更因缘际会遇上微服出游的四皇子胤禛(黄智贤)，二人气味相投，被引进到宫内的御膳房当御厨，天宝遇上宿敌蔡鹤亭(林盛斌)，掀起连场龙争虎斗；但天宝万料不到自己竟卷入由八皇子胤禩(张继聪)策动的夺嫡之争中，在劣势下天宝成了胤禛的福将，连番替他反败为胜，但一段意外的婚约却令天宝由一人之下顿贬为丧家狗……

programme.title: 坚离地爱坚离地
programme.desc: 在香港，投身金融、地产、商业是「贴地」举动，富二代王子菲(龚嘉欣饰)却偏爱「离地」，与好友许正伟(陈智燊饰)开设初创科技公司。一次网络黑客事件让子菲见识到IT奇才丁信希(张振朗饰)的厉害，邀他加入公司。信希是一名「离地」毒男，不顾世事，得护士张莱(刘佩钥饰)帮助走出不善沟通的围墙，对她好感渐生；子菲与信希经历分歧，至同心及互补不足，不经意对他产生情愫……子菲本相信科技为世界带来美好，但网络风波相继发生在其父王守勤(李国麟饰)、弟王梓龙(罗梓龙饰)、信希之妹丁信恩(黄心颖饰)身上！

programme.desc: Emily Chang meets Disney Entertainment Co-Chair Dana Walden and a cast of Disney stars for an inside look at the entertainment giant's global streaming and TV operations.

programme.desc: 23andMe Institute CEO Anne Wojcicki. Emily meets 23andMe Institute Chief Executive Officer Anne Wojcicki for a discussion of the rise, fall and rebirth of the personal genetics company.

programme.title: Inside Jeffrey Epstein's Network of Power
programme.desc: Jeffrey Epstein built a network of elites across finance, politics and academia. By analyzing thousands of documents, Bloomberg mapped its reach and how it widened even as allegations against him accumulated.

programme.title: Tesla's Dangerous Doors
programme.desc: A number of fatal car crashes involving Tesla vehicles has prompted increased scrutiny of its electric doors, triggering lawsuits over whether the design can leave passengers trapped.

programme.desc: China’s Greater Bay Area will fuse 11 cities into a megalopolis that includes Hong Kong, which Beijing hopes will become a new Silicon Valley. But the plan is part of a much larger transformation.

programme.title: The Race to Build Data Centers in Space
programme.desc: “Data centers in space” may sound like science fiction, but as the SpaceX IPO augurs a space boom, tech giants and startups are betting orbital artificial intelligence is the next frontier.

programme.title: A Dangerous Corner of the Global Shipping Industry

programme.title: Sex-for-Work Claims in West Africa's Rubber Industry
programme.desc: An activist seeking to address the alleged abuses contends she has been targeted with litigation to keep her quiet, which the company denied.

programme.title: 倾国倾城
programme.desc: 李翰祥史诗式电影，艺术成就及导演功力震惊中港台三地。本片荣获金马优等剧情片、最佳女主角及最佳彩色影片美术设计奖项。影后卢燕饰慈禧太后；处女演出即成名的萧瑶，饰死后受追封为贵妃的珍妃；而为珍妃逝世而不近女色的光绪帝则是狄龙。

programme.title: 倩女幽魂
programme.desc: 年轻书生宁采臣在传说闹鬼的恐怖寺庙里过夜。虽然他不相信传闻，却遇上美丽的女鬼聂小倩。原来聂小倩被困在寺庙中，诱使年轻男子给魔头姥姥享用。宁采臣得悉聂小倩为一只善良的女鬼，于是决定助她逃离魔掌。

programme.title: 人皮灯笼
programme.desc: 赵春方曾于决斗败于龙帅之手下。七年后，龙帅为在赏灯大会上夺魁，往寻赵春方代为制造别致灯笼。赵春方藉此暗中布下复仇大计。龙帅之妻无固失踪后，他惊闻有关人皮灯笼的传说，并开始怀疑赵春方与失踪事件有关......

programme.title: 神经大侠
programme.desc: 威力无敌的兵器鸳鸯刀将要送给满清的皇帝，却不慎落入萧中慧和袁冠南手里。大内高手卓天雄于是出发追捕二人，誓要取回鸳鸯刀。大战一触即发，此刻鸳鸯刀的秘密也同被揭开。

programme.title: 徐老虎与白寡妇
programme.desc: 本片改编自高阳同名著作，获第18届金马奖最佳服装设计、最佳美术设计两项奖。本片讲述清朝食盐私枭徐老虎与白寡妇因清官李振彪拒不受贿，再加上责令严缉私盐，二人面临缉案危机。为免同僚落网，白独担罪责。徐悉白被处死，一心复仇...

programme.title: 保镖
programme.desc: 洛阳无敌庄庄主失去了所有功力，于是请来侄儿与未婚妻一起护送黄金前往京城。在途中，他们遇到了一名神秘侠客，三人随即联手对抗盗匪，竭力保护黄金不被劫走。

programme.title: 瀛台泣血
programme.desc: 清朝末年，光绪帝亲政后，开始着手维新变法，惜改革触犯了想保全自身富贵功名的官僚的阻扰。支持皇帝变法的康有为性格软弱，坚持变法的谭嗣同难免浮躁，光绪深知自己的处境危险，于是企图利用袁世凯去对付握有兵权的荣禄。但在关键时刻，袁世凯见风使舵却向荣禄告了密，出卖了光绪...

programme.title: 盗剑
programme.desc: 韩九重为夺削铁如泥的青霜剑，诱杀师弟谈鹤鸣；谈鹤鸣的妻子耿六娘隐姓埋名在将军府为佣，伺机夺剑报仇。将军女儿娇龙拜六娘为师，练成一身武艺，并与六娘师侄罗翼虎相恋。翼虎顺娇龙之意，深夜到亲王府盗剑，然而寡不敌众，失手被擒；娇龙率众营救，与韩九重等人展开连场激战。

programme.title: 小云雀
programme.desc: 记者仕泰为发掘歌星小云雀的秘密，假扮大亨接近小云雀。后来仕泰的假大亨身份被揭穿，小云雀大怒，请来真正大亨揭穿仕泰的身份。怎料大亨很欣赏仕泰的应变能力，实时聘请他为助手，处理歌星登台事宜。

programme.title: 十二金牌
programme.desc: 南宋年间，朝廷腐败积弱，加上金兵南侵，民生困苦。一代名将岳飞赤胆忠肝，率领岳家军奋勇抗敌，大破金兵，深受百姓爱戴。宋朝丞相秦桧卖国求荣，勾结金国四王子金兀术，设计对付岳飞，以扫除金人入侵中原的最大阻碍。宋高宗为保帝位，纵容秦桧只手遮天，更听从其谗言发出十二道金牌急召岳飞回京。岳飞长子岳云、次子岳雷与王八妹等江湖侠士，为挽救国家危难，千方百计阻截金牌，与秦桧爪牙爆发一场腥风血雨的死战...

programme.title: 洪拳与咏春
programme.desc: 清廷派人扫平少林寺，杀掉所有少林弟子。从中幸存出来的两名弟子，分别拜入咏春及洪拳师傅门下，学习拳法。最终他们挟技击败敌人，并为死去师兄弟报仇。

programme.title: 鬼画符
programme.desc: 周鹏被神捕诸葛森追杀，投靠表兄包妥。林家大少奶被男鬼杜洛所杀，要求鹏二人带其鬼魂上路，到开封找公孙先生消灭杜鬼魂。鹏以大少奶的鬼符在赌场赢取路费，更与戏子吴顺超一同上路...

programme.title: 邪完再邪
programme.desc: 女鬼刘阿翠钟情以前邻居马素，欲与其结合，央求父亲携同金银珠宝向马提亲，撮合一段人鬼姻缘，马素年青憨直，不愿与鬼为伍，坚决拒绝，实则彼暗恋已有男友之邻居红卜卜，阿翠洞悉其情，决定伺机行动。

programme.title: 镖旗飞扬
programme.desc: 凌霄及关望龙同为一流镖师，深得主人器重。关单恋主人孙女方燕，方却情系于凌。关迁怒凌，竟与黑道中人金不换密谋劫镖，嫁祸凌...

programme.title: 拳击
programme.desc: 范克在父亲临终时发现自己有一个同父异母的兄弟汶烈在泰国。于是，他去找汶烈，并发现他为了救治重病中的母亲，而成为一名拳手。两人相遇后，更被牵连在地下拳击赌博当中。

programme.title: 无名英雄
programme.desc: 街头浪荡客孟刚与铁虎虽玩世不恭，却心怀侠义。一次偶然，孟刚结识革命军首领万泰，在其感召下，两兄弟决心投身革命。在孟刚女友的协助下，他们成功潜入军阀阵营，智取军火送往前线。然而，在与军阀的激战中，三人相继壮烈牺牲，成为湮没于历史中的「无名英雄」。

programme.title: 十二金钱镖
programme.desc: 乔茂押镖时，遇女贼袁玉蓉，举刀要杀之际，却被袁的美丽媚态吸引，后两人互生爱慕，更发现凭独门武器「十二金钱镖」名震天下的俞剑平，与背后操控袁的老头，有段血海深仇...

programme.title: 大醉侠
programme.desc: 女侠「金燕子」的兄长被山贼掳走，幸得武功高强的「醉侠」范大悲相助，从作恶多端的寺庙主持手上救出兄长。本片曾代表香港出战第39届奥斯卡金像奖最佳外语片的首轮评选。

programme.title: 仇连环
programme.desc: 仇连环在上海滩以拳头打出天下，乃好勇斗狠的典型人物。仇为了交际花沈菊芳不惜豁出性命，与著名帮会首脑之子及同伴展开连场明争暗斗，亦成为帮会争夺地盘的嫁祸目标。

programme.title: 云泥
programme.desc: 女主角熊素素因不能接受机师男友意外身亡而患上精神分裂症，一天巧遇留学归来的精神科医生黎易非，多次奇幻的相遇令易非和素素卷入三角恋和复杂的内心纠结之中。

programme.title: 射雕英雄传
programme.desc: 郭靖回到中原时，遇上黄蓉，二人一见钟情双双堕入爱河。岂料，同时间欧阳克竟又向黄蓉提亲。于是黄药师决定以比武选婿，对决的胜方可娶女儿黄蓉为妻。经过一轮激战，郭靖最后成功打败欧阳克，夺得美人归。

programme.title: 包剪石沓
programme.desc: 幽默风趣的爱情喜剧，三个年青医生常开道、史瑞科、萧而可，被安排追求院长的三个女儿灵珍、灵珊、灵玲。三人以「包、剪、搥」来决定追求对象，他们的追女桥段层出不穷，用尽英雄救美、苦肉计、死缠烂打等爱情药方，却全部失灵，乌龙百出...

programme.title: 钟馗娘子
programme.desc: 钟馗娘子被邪恶的黑金刚击败后，隐居多年，处心积虑要复仇。女侠翠屏勇猛坚毅，为铲除黑金刚，恳求钟馗娘子收她为徒。娘子与翠屏两师徒联手对付黑金刚，也是他大限将至的时侯。

programme.title: 人蛇鼠
programme.desc: 庄家农场独子庄士德海外归来，接手由胡麟管理的产业。胡一直与德之表妹曼玲勾结，图取庄家产业，并欲利用曼玲美色迷惑德！怎知在阿芬饲养的小蛇「西西」帮助下，反令德与芬结成夫妇。后来胡买来一条专咬人的野老鼠，欲将德之初生婴儿咬死，「西西」为救婴儿，与野鼠作殊死搏斗...

programme.title: 碧血剑
programme.desc: 此片改编自金庸小说，描述一名将士逃亡时，发现一把宝剑、一本武林秘笈、一份藏宝图和揭开暗藏于武林大侠尸首上之秘密信息后，随即引发一场武林浩劫。

programme.title: 降头
programme.desc: 狄龙剧中为一准新郎，但却遇上心术不正的恬妮单恋痴缠，更借助邪术降头，务求夺取男方欢心。后恬妮裙下之臣罗烈及狄龙未婚妻，亦相继加入战团。一场因为爱而生与死的斗争，复杂的关系加上正邪大斗法，将人性为达一己私欲的恶行，表露无遗。至于邪是否不能胜正？且看结局便有分晓。

programme.desc: Nina and Leon, two little mice, live in a bookshop whose mascot is a large yeti cuddly toy called Yetili. Each evening, once the bookshop has closed, Yetili comes to life and settles his two friends on his knees ready to read them a story.

programme.title: Draw a duck
programme.desc: Koumi is 6 years old, mischievous and always full of fun. The dream of her life is to know all the animals of the world, and she absolutely loves drawing! In each episode she explains how to draw animals really well.

programme.title: Draw an ostrich
programme.desc: Koumi is 6 years old, mischievous and always full of fun. The dream of her life is to know all the animals of the world, and she absolutely loves drawing! In each episode she explains how to draw animals really well.

programme.title: Mastering decimal division
programme.desc: Iman, a former maths teacher, offers primary school pupils a survival kit to help them approach secondary school with confidence. In each episode, using a fun and educational approach, he aims to make his subject clear and practical.

programme.title: Binoculars
programme.desc: What would life be like without our most everyday objects? Each episode puts a different one in the spotlight. Whether a tap, an umbrella or a toothbrush, they all have a story to tell about their invention and subsequent evolution.

programme.title: I love myself
programme.desc: At 8 years old, Amir leads the life of an everyday superhero. Thanks to his online avatar, he raises awareness among the children who watch him and throughout his neighborhood about civility and citizenship.

programme.title: SOS Swans in Distress
programme.desc: Belfort, the king's dog, and Lupin, the wolf of the gardens, live in the Palace of Versailles. As inseparable as they are unlikely, they come to the rescue of all their furry and feathered friends, from the royal menagerie to the local wildlife.

programme.title: Candyfloss
programme.desc: The triplets may look like angels, but they're not the last to get up to mischief... The two brothers and the sister are inseparable and as loving as they are mischievous. The adults need to be brave to channel their energy!

programme.title: The lion, the circus and the canon-robot
programme.desc: Twelve year-old Chloe is feeling somewhat disillusioned. Then Potobot, a little robot arrives from the future with a mission for her: to change the world and make the future a better place. There's no doubt about it, working together, one step after another, the two of them can move mountains!

programme.title: The Pilot
programme.desc: The city of Belmont is preparing to host the universal science fair. Liam, an android with the appearance of a teenager, is getting ready to flee the laboratory where he was created: because he is starting to feel emotions, his creator wants to reset him.

programme.title: Self-confidence
programme.desc: Eight year-old Tata arrives in a new school. She wants to join its football team but isn't allowed to; after all she's a girl! Refusing to be beaten, Tata decides to set up her own girls' team with the help of her gang of friends.

programme.title: The revenge of the wind
programme.desc: Simiouni discovers that Professor Noukira trapped him by forcing him to denounce himself. Touria devotes herself entirely to her studies and spends her time revising her lessons.

programme.title: Mission Info
programme.desc: News programme aimed at 7 to 11-year-olds! Each episode, devised for children and their parents, provides insight accessible to younger ones, combined with explanations, immersive reports and expert interviews. An educational quiz also gives children the chance to test their knowledge in a fun way.

programme.title: Matiere Grise
programme.desc: The magazine programme which takes the mystery out of science, encouraging us to think... without all the brain work!

programme.title: Lauriane Gillieron
programme.desc: Meeting Lauriane Gillieron and her adoptive sister Florence. They don't share the same surname yet grew up together. Coming from Angola and left to fend for herself, Florence naturally found her place in the Gillieron family, which already had three children. They start a dialogue to share essential truths...

programme.title: Valerie Courbon, Florian Gibaud
programme.desc: The different attitudes and approaches of French farmers in terms of the environment, economy and landscape. A practical way of understanding a region and its terroir through their working practices.

programme.title: Stoemp, Peket... Et Des Rawettes
programme.desc: A veritable celebration of Belgium's regions, along with the locals who live there, their regional languages... and their humour!

programme.title: Germany (2)
programme.desc: In Berlin, Viola and Jan explore an urban monastery founded by Swiss people and home to several families. Then on to Hamburg, where the German adventure ends in... a theatre and with a nomadic couple who travel across Europe in a bus.

programme.title: Au Bonheur Des Livres
programme.desc: Around a chosen theme, Claire Chazal welcomes two authors: novelists, biographers, essayists or historians, and shares viewers' literary favorites.

programme.title: Hasni Bekheira (Algeria)
programme.desc: Hasni Bekheira grew up in Grenoble, in the Teisseire neighborhood, where he learned hairdressing at a very young age. Without a diploma but driven by passion, he created Street Coiff. The principle: a chair, clippers and free haircuts for homeless people or detainees. Today recognized, he is proud of this tool of dignity and dialogue.

programme.title: David Popovici
programme.desc: Double world champion in the 100 meters and 200 meters freestyle in 2022 and 2025, European champion in the same distances, Olympic champion in Paris in the 200 meters and bronze medalist in the 100 meters: Pierre Classen welcomes Romanian swimmer David Popovici.

programme.title: Le Telejournal De Radio-Canada
programme.desc: The televised news programme from the Radio-Canada team.

programme.title: Rosa Kanno (Paris) / Sarah Levy (Brussels)
programme.desc: Rosa Kanno, eco-responsible stylist, creates made-to-measure clothing. Rejecting fast fashion, Rosa designs dresses using 3D modeling, which allows her to adjust creations to the clients' body shapes and limit fabric waste. A Franco-Belgian accessories designer, Sarah Levy creates hybrid pieces designed to free the body and adapt to contemporary movement. Committed to local and sustainable production, she works with Brussels workshops to refine her prototypes in leather and recycled nylon.

programme.title: Of Soul and Objects
programme.desc: Vreni gives a soul to objects. To those she builds, repairs or adopts. Her house, like her life, is filled with them.

programme.title: Marie-Josee Talbot, trekking guide in Greenland
programme.desc: In the small hamlet of Kulusuk, Greenland, the guide Marie-Josee Talbot welcomes hikers from Quebec. The group is ready to walk several hours per day to discover the fjords and glaciers of the coast, the wonders of a still unspoilt environment.

programme.title: Pierre Herme / Imai jewellery
programme.desc: We meet a man of excellent taste, the French pastry chef and chocolatier Pierre Herme, undisputed king of the macaroon and much more. Learn all about the story of the Perfecto. Fancy jewellery by Imai: in keeping with contemporary styles. The right way to wear a shirt.

programme.desc: At 8 years old, Amir leads the life of an everyday superhero. Thanks to his online avatar, he raises awareness among the children who watch him and throughout his neighborhood about civility and citizenship.

programme.title: Sushi Party

There's no doubt about it, working together, one step after another, the two of them can move mountains!

programme.title: Access Denied

programme.title: The balance of the sky
programme.desc: Touria is a brilliant and diligent student, which soon arouses the jealousy of the other students.

programme.title: Don't play with fire

programme.title: When the knives are out
programme.desc: When a man is adamant about have escaped a murder attempt and accuses his partner's ex-husband, the police pay little attention.
